ocr.menuHint: Reads the text in a picture and turns it into editable text boxes and tables, or lays a searchable text layer over it
ocr.title: Text Recognition (OCR)
ocr.hint: Runs on this computer only. The picture never leaves it.
ocr.ready: Choose a language and an output, then press Recognize.
ocr.stats: Lines: {lines} · Tables: {tables} · Check boxes: {checks} · Skew corrected: {angle}° · {ms} ms
ocr.lang.label: Language
ocr.mode.label: Output
ocr.mode.rebuildHint: Recreates paragraphs, tables and check boxes as text boxes and tables in their original places. The original picture stays underneath, locked.
ocr.mode.layerHint: Keeps the picture as it is and lays invisible text over it: selectable, searchable and copyable; saved as PDF it becomes a searchable PDF.
ocr.showImage: Keep the original picture visible underneath
ocr.doubtful: Characters to check: {n} (yellow; hover for the other candidate)
ocr.note: Applying can be undone in one step
ocr.err.noModel: The text recognition model isn't installed (models/ocr folder).
ocr.err.tooLarge: The picture is too large ({w}×{h}). Reduce it to 120 million pixels or fewer, then recognize the text
